needs_atom.missing: Clause 'When this creature enters, you may have your life total become the total toughness of creatures you control.': no atom sets a life total (CR 119.5); the Verb set has GAIN_LIFE/LOSE_LIFE only. Composing it as a Seq of GAIN_LIFE(SUB(total, life)) and LOSE_LIFE(SUB(life, total)) is not the same: each step re-reads the life total, so a life-gain replacement (ORI Alhammarret's Archive doubling the gain) makes the second step take the excess back, which a single set-life does not. Missing: a SET_LIFE atom (player, amount) that gains or loses the difference as one event. The quantity exists: QProp(referent=Selector(creatures you control), field=TOUGHNESS, agg=SUM), as in Volcanic Salvo's total power. Not the blocker: '{5}{W}: This creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.' is MODIFY_PT with QProp('controller', LIFE).
